name: Parking Facilities
description: Parking facility locations, capacity, and occupancy

quality.realtimeStale: Realtime availability is older than 30 minutes.
quality.freeSpacesClamped: Realtime free-space count exceeded capacity and was clamped.
quality.negativeFreeSpacesClamped: Realtime free-space count was negative and was clamped to 0.

parkapi-v2.purpose: Real-time parking lot availability across European cities (ParkenDD aggregator covering ~12 cities in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and neighbours)
parkapi-v2.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the full city catalogue and per-city lots on a schedule
parkapi-v2.dataReceived: City list with coordinates and source info; per-city lots with name, address, coordinates, total/free capacity

parkapi-v3.purpose: German parking sites with real-time occupancy data (MobiData BW ParkAPI v3 aggregator spanning multiple Baden-Württemberg and federal operators)
parkapi-v3.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire parking-sites dataset on a schedule
parkapi-v3.dataReceived: Parking sites with name, address, coordinates, capacity, realtime free capacity, type, fee info, opening hours

db-bahnpark.purpose: Deutsche Bahn station parking facilities across Germany (single operator)
db-bahnpark.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire facilities dataset on a schedule using subscription credentials (DB Client ID and API key)
db-bahnpark.dataReceived: Parking facilities with name, address, coordinates, capacity, tariff/pricing, accessibility, EV charging info

rdw-nl.purpose: Netherlands parking garages, Park & Ride, and carpool facilities from the national RDW open-data register
rdw-nl.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the full RDW datasets (specs plus the garage/P+R/carpool geo sets) on a schedule
rdw-nl.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, type (garage/P+R/carpool), capacity, EV charging point count, disabled access flag, max vehicle height

bnls-fr.purpose: French parking facilities from the national BNLS register (Base nationale des lieux de stationnement aggregator)
bnls-fr.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire BNLS GeoJSON export on a schedule
bnls-fr.dataReceived: Facility ID, name, coordinates, total spaces, free/paid status, facility type, hourly/daily/monthly pricing, disabled/EV/P+R space counts, max height, address

ghent-be.purpose: Real-time parking garage occupancy in Ghent, Belgium (single-city open-data feed)
ghent-be.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire dataset on a schedule
ghent-be.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, total/available capacity, occupancy percentage, open/closed status, occupancy trend, operator

brussels-be.purpose: Static parking facility data for Brussels, Belgium (single-city open-data portal)
brussels-be.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire dataset on a schedule
brussels-be.dataReceived: Facility name (FR/NL), coordinates, capacity, disabled capacity, max height, floors, operator, address

basel-ch.purpose: Real-time parking garage occupancy in Basel, Switzerland (canton open-data portal)
basel-ch.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the latest dataset snapshots on a schedule
basel-ch.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, free/total spaces, address

opentransportdata-ch-parking.purpose: Bike and car parking facilities across Switzerland from the national open data platform mobility (opentransportdata.swiss aggregator)
opentransportdata-ch-parking.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire bike-and-car-parking dataset on a schedule
opentransportdata-ch-parking.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, capacity, derived free spaces (from current estimated occupancy), parking layout type

cita-lu.purpose: Parking facilities in Luxembourg from the CITA DATEX II feed (national mobility authority)
cita-lu.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire static DATEX II XML feed on a schedule
cita-lu.dataReceived: Parking site name, coordinates, capacity, real-time free spaces and occupancy status, address

florence-it.purpose: Real-time parking availability in Florence, Italy (single-city open-data portal)
florence-it.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire ParkFreeSpot dataset on a schedule
florence-it.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, free spaces count, last update timestamp

barcelona-es.purpose: Static parking facility data for Barcelona, Spain (single-city open-data portal)
barcelona-es.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire dataset on a schedule
barcelona-es.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, address, district, neighborhood, status

vienna-at.purpose: Static parking garages and P+R facilities in Vienna, Austria (single-city open-data WFS service)
vienna-at.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire WFS feature collection on a schedule
vienna-at.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, operator, address, P+R flag, disabled access flag, website

copenhagen-dk.purpose: Static parking garage data for Copenhagen, Denmark (single-city open-data WFS service)
copenhagen-dk.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire WFS feature collection on a schedule
copenhagen-dk.dataReceived: Street name, house number, postal district, capacity, type (underground/garage), owner

singapore.purpose: Real-time car park availability across Singapore (national open-data portal aggregating HDB carparks)
singapore.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire availability and static datasets on a schedule
singapore.dataReceived: Car park number, lot type, total/available lots, address, coordinates (SVY21 converted to WGS84), car park type

madrid-es.purpose: Static parking facility data for Madrid, Spain (single-city open-data portal)
madrid-es.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire dataset on a schedule
madrid-es.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, address, capacity (from description), schedule, P+R designation, operator

utmc-newcastle.purpose: Real-time car park data for Newcastle/Tyne & Wear, UK (NE Travel Data UTMC feed)
utmc-newcastle.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire static and dynamic car-park feeds on a schedule using UTMC credentials (username/password)
utmc-newcastle.dataReceived: Car park name, coordinates, capacity, free spaces, state (open/closed/full)

nsw-au.purpose: Real-time Park & Ride car park data for Greater Sydney, Australia (Transport for NSW open data)
nsw-au.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the car-park list and per-facility occupancy on a schedule using the NSW Transport API key
nsw-au.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, capacity, available spaces, occupancy

ndw-truck-nl.purpose: Real-time truck parking availability along Dutch highways (NDW national open-data DATEX II feeds)
ndw-truck-nl.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire static table and dynamic status XML feeds on a schedule
ndw-truck-nl.dataReceived: Truck parking facilities with name, coordinates, capacity, real-time vacant/occupied spaces, amenities (charging, toilet, shower)

autobahn-de.purpose: German Autobahn rest area and truck parking facilities (Autobahn GmbH national feed)
autobahn-de.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the road list and per-road parking data on a schedule
autobahn-de.dataReceived: Rest area name, coordinates, car/truck parking capacity, blocked status, amenities (toilet, fuel, restaurant, WiFi, shower)

opendatahub-it.purpose: Parking stations in South Tyrol, Italy (Open Data Hub regional aggregator)
opendatahub-it.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire station list and latest measurements on a schedule
opendatahub-it.dataReceived: Station name (multilingual), coordinates, capacity, real-time occupied/free spaces, parking layout type, EV charging availability

nrw-mobidrom-pr.purpose: NRW.Mobidrom bundled Park+Ride data (VRR, Bielefeld, Bonn, Köln, Münster, Oberhausen) — regional Park+Ride aggregator
nrw-mobidrom-pr.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire aggregate DATEX II Parking Light feed on a schedule
nrw-mobidrom-pr.dataReceived: Park+Ride site name, coordinates, capacity, real-time availability where provided, fee info, address; every record flagged as P+R

nrw-mobidrom-parking.purpose: NRW.Mobidrom bundled parking data (Düsseldorf, Köln, Bielefeld, Krefeld, Wuppertal, Aachen plus operator static data) — regional parking aggregator
nrw-mobidrom-parking.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire aggregate DATEX II Parking Light feed on a schedule
nrw-mobidrom-parking.dataReceived: Parking site name, coordinates, capacity, real-time availability, occupancy trend, parking type, fee/tariff, opening hours, address, disabled and EV assignments

apcoa.purpose: APCOA Deutschland parking facilities via the NRW.Mobidrom exporter (single operator, openly licensed lineage)
apcoa.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the operator feed on a schedule
apcoa.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, capacity, address, tariff info, opening hours, equipment tags

apag.purpose: APAG Aachener Parkhaus real-time garage data from the operator's own PMS API (single operator, Aachen)
apag.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the operator's facilities feed on a schedule
apag.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, capacity, real-time available spaces, occupancy trend, address, tariff info, equipment tags

apag-mobidrom.purpose: APAG Aachener Parkhaus garage data via the NRW.Mobidrom exporter (single operator, Aachen; openly licensed backup lineage for the direct APAG feed)
apag-mobidrom.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the operator feed on a schedule
apag-mobidrom.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, capacity, real-time available spaces, occupancy trend, address, tariff info, equipment tags

goldbeck.purpose: GOLDBECK Parking Services static garage data via the NRW.Mobidrom exporter (single operator)
goldbeck.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the operator feed on a schedule
goldbeck.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, address, tariff info, opening hours

braunschweig-de.purpose: Real-time parking garage data for Braunschweig, Germany (city PULP feed, single city)
braunschweig-de.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire PULP GeoJSON feed on a schedule
braunschweig-de.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, capacity, parking type, real-time free spaces, fee info

bremen-de.purpose: Static parking catalogue for Bremen, Germany (VMZ Bremen city feed, single city)
bremen-de.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire parking GeoJSON catalogue on a schedule
bremen-de.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, parking type, max height, fee info

duesseldorf-de.purpose: Real-time parking garage data for Düsseldorf, Germany (city VT-Manager WFS service, single city)
duesseldorf-de.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire WFS feature collection on a schedule
duesseldorf-de.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, capacity, real-time free spaces, fee and tariff info, address, opening hours, max height, disabled spaces

salzburg-at.purpose: Parking facility data for the city of Salzburg, Austria (city WFS service, single city)
salzburg-at.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire WFS feature collection on a schedule
salzburg-at.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, capacity, fee and tariff info, address, opening hours, operator, real-time free spaces and occupancy trend where provided

bielefeld-de.purpose: Parking facility data for Bielefeld, Germany (city WFS service with embedded PLS live counts, single city)
bielefeld-de.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire WFS feature collection on a schedule
bielefeld-de.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, capacity, real-time free spaces, fee info, address, max height, disabled spaces, EV charging spaces, opening hours

bamberg-de.purpose: Real-time parking garage occupancy for Bamberg, Germany (Stadtwerke Bamberg carparkcounter feed, single operator)
bamberg-de.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire status feed on a schedule
bamberg-de.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, capacity, real-time free spaces, fee info, address, operator

trier-de.purpose: Real-time parking garage occupancy for Trier, Germany (Stadtwerke Trier parken-v2 feed, single operator)
trier-de.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire parken-v2 XML feed on a schedule
trier-de.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, capacity, real-time free spaces, fee info, operator, opening hours

potsdam-de.purpose: Parking facility data for Potsdam, Germany (Stadtwerke Potsdam CSV feed, single operator)
potsdam-de.dataSent: No user data; our server's data-manager fetches the entire parking CSV feed on a schedule
potsdam-de.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, capacity, real-time free spaces where provided, fee info, operator, Park+Ride flag

osm.purpose: Parking facilities from OpenStreetMap (global crowdsourced data, static, no real-time availability)
osm.dataSent: An Overpass QL query containing the current map view's bounding-box coordinates (querying amenity=parking nodes and ways); OSM element type and ID for detail lookup
osm.dataReceived: OSM elements with name, coordinates, capacity, fee, access, operator, opening hours
